name: infra_ddp_sampler_bug
title: torchrun DDP written wrong: no sampler.set_epoch, every rank writes the checkpoint, no zero_grad
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-infra: the defective half of the DDP twin pair
note: Two of the three planted defects have no rule in the catalog today and therefore cannot be labelled `expected` (docs/ACCURACY.md section 5): a DistributedSampler whose set_epoch() is never called, and a checkpoint written by every rank instead of by rank 0. They are listed under `unruledDefects` so a future rule has a labelled home to move into.

unruledDefects.why: DistributedSampler derives its permutation from (seed, epoch); without set_epoch every rank replays the identical order every epoch, so shuffle=True buys nothing and the model sees one fixed batch order for the whole run
unruledDefects.wouldBeRule: a new MLV1xx: DistributedSampler(shuffle=True) whose set_epoch is never called in the epoch loop

unruledDefects.defect: every rank writes the same checkpoint path
unruledDefects.why: N processes race on one file; the artifact is whichever rank finished last and can be a torn write
unruledDefects.wouldBeRule: a new MLV8xx: a checkpoint write inside a distributed job with no `if rank == 0` / is_main_process guard

expected.defect: the batch loop calls backward() (line 78) and optimizer.step() (line 80) but never zero_grad()
expected.why: gradients accumulate across every batch of the epoch, so each update is the running sum of everything since the epoch started

expected.defect: the DDP wrapper object itself is pickled rather than ddp_model.module.state_dict()
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and the DDP wrapper, so it cannot be loaded outside this file's import layout or on a single process

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with sampler=train_sampler; the missing set_epoch is a different defect and shuffle= may not be passed alongside a sampler at all
the validation sampler is constructed with shuffle=False and the eval loader passes no shuffle=
the module ends in `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` and every loader is built inside main()'s call tree
optimizer.step() is called at line 80; the missing call is zero_grad(), which is MLV201 above
backward() at line 78 precedes step() at line 80 - the order is right, only the zeroing is absent
the epoch loss is accumulated as running += loss.item(), a Python float
evaluate() calls model.eval() at line 87 and restores model.train() at line 98
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 85
both loops move every batch value with .to(device, non_blocking=True), and the model is moved at line 115
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at lines 43 and 45
seed_everything() at line 112 calls random.seed, numpy.random.seed, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all
